title: Goofy Ahh Dora
blurb: Childhood educational programming, deep-fried well past the point of map-reading capability. Processing kids' TV into brainrot is now a fully established genre, and Dora is its patron saint for a specific reason: she is familiar enough that everybody recognises her instantly, and the distortion has something to work against. The comedy comes from the collision of a voice designed to be soothing and reassuring with compression that makes it sound like it is being transmitted from inside a washing machine. Swiper, regrettably, could not stop the audio quality from going.
